messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled traffic shift for router-service v12.4 -> v12.5 at 2025-11-03T22:00Z. Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% if green. Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx rate >0.5% (5m) or p95 latency >500ms (5m). Release notes: https://redwood/release/2025-11-03/v12.5

alex: Oncall here, I'll kick off and monitor. I'll run synthetic traffic and watch logs/trace.

maria: @alex quick q — should we pin critical routes to stable during the initial ramp? there's a cookie-affinity tweak in this build.

jamal: Yes, pin /api/v1/chat and /v1/embeds to stable-v12.4 for first 30m if anything odd. I'll create the pin rule now.

router-ops: Drain/warmpool note: warm instances for 15m before increasing weight. Command: ```rbctl drain router-pool-us-east --grace 900``` Do not fully drain until 25% step passes.

alex: Starting canary in ~2m. 5% for 10m then we evaluate. I'll announce step changes.

sre-oncall: Monitoring hooks set: alert if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 > 500ms over 5m. Trace sampling increased to 20% for the window. Playbook: https://redwood/playbooks/traffic-shift

maria: Manual rollback helper saved: ```rbctl traffic set router-service --weight stable=100``` Keep that command handy.

jamal: Running health probes during canary: ```curl -sSf https://router-us-east/health || echo FAIL``` and a short k6 run for 2m from us-east probe node.

alex: Update 22:12 — 10m @5% complete, no alerts. planning move to 25% in 2m.

deploy-bot: CI smoke checks passed post-shift step. Changelog updated: "router: fix sticky session bug; improve header passthrough; tweak affinity timeout".

maria: If we see bursty 429s on the ingress, we'll pin back to stable and open a follow-up. ping me immediately.

jamal: Holding on full 100% until final verification. If anything spikes I'll trigger the rollback command above.

alex: Final update 23:08 — shifted to 100%, all blue/green checks green, no regression signals. Closing change window. Thanks everyone :shipit:
